description: Use when the user pastes a DMARC record to explain or check before publishing. Returns p, sp, np, adkim, aspf, rua, ruf and unknown tags, with the same findings as dmarc. No DNS lookups. Ex: 'Explain v=DMARC1; p=none'. Free trial without an API key: a few calls a day.
name: dmarc_parse
title: DMARC record parser
